name: quorum
title: Quorum
description: A parish-council theme on plain notice paper: under a black masthead bar each meeting is posted as a PUBLIC NOTICE, a sheet framed and ruled across in heavy black, its date, time and place captioned and the clerk’s line at the foot; one ink, one neo-grotesque, councillors in a ruled register.

tokens.--font-sans: the one type family, for every heading, label and line of text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the bold capitals: name, menu, PUBLIC NOTICE, captions, statuses, tags, table heads
tokens.--color-bg: the notice paper: the ground of pages and notices, and the letters of a cancelled status
tokens.--color-text: the ink: all text, and the ground of a cancelled status
tokens.--color-muted: quieter ink: event and news descriptions, places in the regular week, past event dates, the page count, the footer note
tokens.--color-rule: the heavy rules: a notice’s frame and the rules across it, register and table heads, status, tag and join-link boxes
tokens.--color-hair: the thin rules between events, regular times, people, news items and table rows, and the clerk’s signing line
tokens.--color-bar-ink: the name, founded line, menu and current-entry mark on the masthead bar
tokens.--size-h1: page headlines and an event title on its notice
tokens.--size-title: size of event and news titles in lists, a notice’s heading, and an event’s date, time and place
tokens.--size-small: size of small capitals: the issuer above PUBLIC NOTICE, captions, the clerk’s office, news dates
tokens.--rule-heavy: weight of the heavy rules and a notice frame
tokens.--sign-gap: blank space above the clerk’s signing line
tokens.--sign-line: least length of the signing line
tokens.--measure-wide: maximum width of masthead, content and footer
tokens.--measure-notice: maximum width of a notice standing alone, the news list and a news item
tokens.--col-when: width of the date column in event and news lists
tokens.--space-2: small gap inside labels and under headings
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on phones, padding of a ruled line
tokens.--space-5: large gap above content and at the foot
